Setup is a one-off fee

We take your existing spreadsheets, load the equipment, parts and open jobs into MainteNeat, and train the team on site. For the first plants we do the whole configuration ourselves, so day one starts with a system that already has your machines in it.

Quoted per site, once, on top of the monthly subscription.
